messages:
anya: Quick follow-up from today's RFC — sketch for a layerwise hydration 'supply chain' idea.

sam: gist?

anya: idea: each shard exposes per-layer readiness hints + a small budget token pool. Loader agents request 'supply' for layers proactively up to budget, otherwise fallback to on-demand streaming.

mike: so budget is per-model-session or global per-host? how do we avoid duplicate prefetch across concurrent requests?

anya: budget granularity: session-scoped (short leases) + host-level backpressure token bucket. Lease issued by weight-server with a TTL. If another loader sees active lease, it skips prefetch.

jordan: main risks: lease leaks and stale budgets -> OOM thrash. Need eviction callbacks and a heartbeat/renewal path.

katy: heartbeat freq options: 500ms vs 2s. 500ms reduces stale windows but increases costs. Tradeoff depends on request qps.

sam: observability: we must record per-layer cold-miss, prefetch-hit, lease-grant-duration histograms and surfaced in Console. Also expose a simple "supply_status" endpoint on weightserver for debugging.

mike: surface/API changes: add `RequestWarmup(layer_ids, budget_tokens)` RPC on the weights protocol + `X-Warmup-Lease: <lease-id>` header on subsequent fetches. Example proto sketch:

```proto
rpc RequestWarmup(Request) returns (WarmupLease) { }
message WarmupLease { string lease_id = 1; repeated int32 layer_ids = 2; int64 expires_at = 3; }
```

anya: fallback: if weightserver or transport doesn't support lease RPC, loader should gracefully fall back to index-first streaming with smaller chunk sizes to reduce tail latency.

evan-bot: deploy-bot: proposal ready for gated rollout. Can we A/B this? feature flag `layerwise-supply-v1` suggested.

katy: rollout plan: canary -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automatic rollback triggers (cold-miss rate spike > 5% or memory pressure above configured threshold).

jordan: one more system-level point: shard placement optimizer must be aware of supply budgets so it doesn't colocate multiple very-hot layers on a single GPU, otherwise leases will collide and nullify benefit.

sam: good call. That implies we need a hint API from scheduler: `expected_warm_budget(layer)`. Scheduler can then spread hot-layer replicas.

anya: implementation plan:
- add lease RPC + header, minimal proto.
- loader: lease manager + local token bucket + eviction hooks.
- weightserver: lightweight lease table + metrics endpoint.
- simulator: micro-bench harness to model contention and worst-case leak scenarios.

mike: perf test idea: synthetic trace with mixed short/long prefix workloads to measure wasted prefetch tokens and hit improvement. I'll help build it.

sam: I'll draft the RFC follow-up PR with headers, proto, and canary rollout notes by EOD tomorrow.

anya: awesome — I'll start a small sim repo and add unit tests for lease expiration + stale-lease recovery.

mike: ping @sam when PR up, happy to review. :thumbsup:
